name: type: bug
description: A plugin or the marketplace does not behave as documented

name: type: feature
description: New capability or improvement for an existing plugin or the marketplace

name: type: plugin-proposal
description: Proposal for a new plugin, skill, or agent

name: type: docs
description: Documentation is missing, wrong, or unclear

name: type: maintenance
description: Tooling, CI, dependencies, or refactors with no user-visible change

name: type: security
description: Security hardening — report vulnerabilities privately (SECURITY.md)

name: status: needs-triage
description: Awaiting maintainer triage

name: status: needs-info
description: Waiting on the author; closes as not planned after 21 days without a reply

name: status: accepted
description: Triaged and accepted; open for work

name: status: blocked
description: Blocked by an upstream change or another issue

name: status: stale
description: No author reply for 14 days; closes in 7 more

name: priority: critical
description: Breaks installs or loses data; fix before anything else

name: priority: high
description: Important; next in line

name: priority: low
description: Nice to have

name: area: plugins
description: Changes under plugins/

name: area: catalog
description: Marketplace catalog, schemas, and catalog generation

name: area: ci
description: GitHub Actions workflows

name: area: tooling
description: Repo scripts, npm config, and Claude Code project hooks

name: area: templates
description: Reusable templates under templates/

name: area: docs
description: Documentation under docs/ and root Markdown files

name: area: community
description: Issue forms, PR template, labels, and community health files

name: bump: major
description: Computed: PR bumps a plugin's MAJOR version (breaking change)

name: bump: minor
description: Computed: PR bumps a plugin's MINOR version (new capability)

name: bump: patch
description: Computed: PR bumps a plugin's PATCH version (fix)

name: bump: prerelease
description: Computed: PR bumps a plugin to a prerelease version

name: bump: initial
description: Computed: PR adds a new plugin at its first version

name: bump: none
description: Computed: PR changes no plugin version

name: bump: deferred
description: Maintainer-applied: runtime files changed without a bump; reaches users with the next bump

name: good first issue
description: Good for newcomers

name: help wanted
description: Extra attention is needed
